_meta.writes_to_dental: none; the dental workspace was read only and nothing was committed there
searched: local_path/results/LANE_*/ and PROOF_LANE_*/ and DEMO48_PACKAGE/: every .json under 8 MB, 46109 files, indexed to numeric leaves with full key paths
local_path/results/LANE_XREVIEW_BATCH*/ and PROOF_LANE_XREVIEW_*/: 553 REVIEW_*.json, indexed separately to 35879 numeric leaves and searched first
no night_rounds/r*.json directory exists anywhere under dental/results; the per-round artefacts are the per-job results.json, which is what was searched
_meta.method: Every candidate was accepted only after reading the quantity's own definition in its source block and the job's own provenance strings. Units were taken from the quantity's meaning, not from the key suffix; see unit_basis on each proposal. Any candidate whose source calls it assumed, declared, illustrative, chosen or calibrated-to-a-target is marked measured:false with the source's own wording in source_self_description.
_meta.reviewed_vs_unreviewed_note: No numeric value usable for any of the 57 edges was found inside a REVIEW_*.json itself; those files carry recount counts, verdicts and gate flags rather than the physical quantities. Every proposal therefore cites the job's own results.json or input file, and records in source_review_state the XREVIEW verdict that job received. All 7 filled edges draw on jobs whose XREVIEW verdict is HOLDS, HOLDS_WITH_CORRECTION or DEMO_READY; none draws on a job with no review.
_meta.commonest_unfilled_reason: The required_measurement asks for an independent same-specimen physical observation that dental has never acquired (uCT, paired IOS+CBCT on one subject, histology, clinical time series, physical seated film). Dental's own output records the absence: measured_seated_film = 0, new_physical_measurements = 0, physical_certificates = 0, human_paired_complete_arms = 0.

proposals.same_quantity_justification: required_measurement item 'Effective PDL modulus conditional on rate/geometry/nu'. This is the effective PDL Young's modulus for the upper central incisor at nu=0.45 under the F1 static loading protocol. Note the unit is MPa, a pressure; the edge's declared unit mm belongs to the displacement component (0.15 mm), not to this component.
proposals.source_self_description: parameter_status = CONDITIONAL_POPULATION_CALIBRATION; /chains/K13/uncertainty says 'Conditional source-force interpolation of six old FE samples'. The value is back-solved so the archived FE curves reproduce the in-vivo incisor force at 0.15 mm, i.e. chosen to produce a target, not measured.
